content_html:
AI blog and article writing service: researched, human-edited content that ranks and gets cited

Our AI article writing service turns your target keywords and customer questions into clear, accurate blogs and articles. AI does the research and first draft quickly. Then our editors check every fact, add your expertise and set up each post for Google, answer boxes and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Gemini.

What is an AI article writing service?

An AI article writing service uses AI tools to speed up research and drafting, while people stay in charge of quality. So you get more content, faster, without the thin, generic text that pure AI tools often produce.

Google says it rewards helpful, people-first content however it is made. Its guidance on AI-generated content is the standard we write to.

What is included in every blog and article?

  • Keyword and question researchTopics chosen from real search demand and the questions your buyers ask.
  • Search-intent outlineHeadings planned around what the reader wants to know, in order.
  • AI draft, human editAn AI first draft, then a full edit for accuracy, tone and your brand voice.
  • Fact and source checkEvery claim checked, with links to primary sources where it matters.
  • SEO, AEO and GEO setupTitle, meta description, direct answers, FAQs and schema markup.
  • Internal links and imagesLinks to your service pages and alt text on every image.

How does our writing process work?

  1. Brief: first, we agree your audience, topics, tone and goals.
  2. Research: next, we pick keywords and questions with real search demand.
  3. Outline: then we plan headings that match search intent.
  4. Draft: after that, AI writes a first draft from the outline and your notes.
  5. Edit and check: an editor rewrites, checks facts and adds your expertise.
  6. Publish and track: finally, we publish or hand over the post and track rankings, clicks and AI citations.

AI-only vs human-only vs AI with human editing

ApproachSpeedQuality and accuracyBest for
AI-only toolsVery fastOften generic; facts can be wrongRough ideas and internal drafts
Human-only writingSlowHigh, but costly at volumeThought leadership and opinion pieces
AI with human editing (our service)FastHigh: fact-checked and on-brandRegular blogs, guides and service articles

Which types of content do we write?

  • Blog posts that answer common customer questions.
  • Long-form guides and "how to" articles.
  • Comparison and "best of" articles for buyers who are deciding.
  • Local and city pages for businesses that serve several areas.
  • Product and service explainers for ecommerce and B2B sites.

Why choose AI blogs and articles from Openink Hub?

Many AI writing tools stop at the draft. In contrast, our AI article writing service covers the full job: research, writing, editing, SEO setup and tracking. Also, every article is written to be quoted, with direct answers and clear facts, so it can show up in Google AI Overviews and AI chat answers as well as normal search results.

We work in English and Hindi, and we can match your existing brand voice. If you also want a ready-made publishing system, see our AI blog service, which adds distribution and syndication.

How to get started

Share your website, your main services and five topics you want to rank for. We will send a sample outline and a content plan for the first month. To start, contact the Openink Hub team.

Frequently asked questions

What is an AI article writing service?

It uses AI tools for research and first drafts, then human editors check facts, add expertise and set up each article for search and AI answers.

Will Google penalise AI-written articles?

Google says it rewards helpful, people-first content however it is produced. Every article we deliver is edited and fact-checked by a person.

How many articles can you deliver each month?

It depends on length and research needs. Most clients start with four to eight articles a month and scale up once results are clear.

Do you publish the articles for us?

Yes, we can publish to WordPress and most CMS platforms, or hand over ready-to-publish files with titles, meta descriptions and schema.

How do you measure results?

We track rankings, organic clicks, leads from each article and mentions in AI answers, and report them every month.
